notes: The spec explicitly offers two alternative channel definitions ('Bollinger Bands (BB) with a period of 20 and standard deviation of 2' vs 'Alternatively, use a Donchian Channel with a period of 20') and the entry fires on a close above 'either the Bollinger Bands upper line or the Donchian Channel high' — two faithful implementers can pick different channels and produce different fill timestamps. The falling-structure precondition ('at least 3 consecutive lower highs and lower lows') does not say whether highs/lows are per-bar or swing pivots. Exit is under-pinned: stop 'below the lower band' with no offset, and take-profit equals the channel height, which itself depends on the BB-vs-Donchian choice. Sizing is example-only ('e.g., 1% or 2% per trade'; drawdown gate 'e.g., 10%'), and the prose mandates 'the 4-hour (H4) chart' while the binding is AAPL 1h (rows 5082, 2023-08-11 to 2026-07-10) — the pre-registered timeframe-mismatch class. No hardcoded price levels, prose asset is generic, single feed suffices.
